steps.code: local me=Game.GetLocalPlayer(); if me~=0 then error('scenario expects the configured human in slot 0') end; local p=Players[me]; local leader='LEADER_JAC_DATE_TANEMUNE'; local row=GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas[leader]; if not row then error('persona database missing') end; local prefix='JAC_PERSONA_'..leader..'_'; local function prop(k) return Game:GetProperty(prefix..k) end; local def=GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType]; local governors=p:GetGovernors(); local gov=governors:HasGovernor(def.Hash) and governors:GetGovernor(def.Hash) or nil; local count=0; local unit=nil; for _,u in p:GetUnits():Members() do local gp=u:GetGreatPerson(); if gp and gp:IsGreatPerson() and GameInfo.GreatPersonIndividuals[gp:GetIndividual()] and GameInfo.GreatPersonIndividuals[gp:GetIndividual()].GreatPersonIndividualType==row.PersonType then count=count+1; unit=u end end; if prop('STATE')~=nil or count~=0 or gov~=nil then error('leader joined before explicit join') end; if governors:GetGovernorPoints()~=0 then error('official governor title sources restored') end; local n=0; for r in GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas() do n=n+1 end; if n~=22 then error('expected 22 persona definitions, got '..n) end; return 'no automatic joining; 22 definitions; no ordinary title source'

local me=0; local source=nil; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do if PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetLeaderTypeName()=='LEADER_JAC_DATE_TANEMUNE' then source=p:GetID() end end; if source==nil or Players[source]:IsHuman() then error('AI Date leader required') end; local cities=Players[me]:GetCities(); local a=cities:GetCapitalCity(); local b=nil; for _,c in cities:Members() do if c:GetID()~=a:GetID() and (not b or c:GetID()<b:GetID()) then b=c end end; if not a or not b then error('two own cities required') end; Game:SetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_SCENARIO_SOURCE',source); Game:SetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_SCENARIO_CITY_A',a:GetID()); Game:SetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_SCENARIO_CITY_B',b:GetID()); local api=ExposedMembers.JAC_LeaderPersona; if not api then error('gameplay context missing') end; local result=api.Join(me,source,'CALM','ASTUTE'); if result~='JOINED' then error('join failed: '..tostring(result)) end; if not Players[source]:IsAlive() then error('PoC join eliminated the source faction') end; return 'AI Date leader joined human; personality/trait are test inputs, no territory transferred'

local me=Game.GetLocalPlayer(); local p=Players[me]; local leader='LEADER_JAC_DATE_TANEMUNE'; local row=GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas[leader]; if not row then error('persona database missing') end; local prefix='JAC_PERSONA_'..leader..'_'; local function prop(k) return Game:GetProperty(prefix..k) end; local def=GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType]; local governors=p:GetGovernors(); local gov=governors:HasGovernor(def.Hash) and governors:GetGovernor(def.Hash) or nil; local count=0; local unit=nil; for _,u in p:GetUnits():Members() do local gp=u:GetGreatPerson(); if gp and gp:IsGreatPerson() and GameInfo.GreatPersonIndividuals[gp:GetIndividual()] and GameInfo.GreatPersonIndividuals[gp:GetIndividual()].GreatPersonIndividualType==row.PersonType then count=count+1; unit=u end end; if prop('OWNER')~=me or prop('SOURCE')~=Game:GetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_SCENARIO_SOURCE') then error('identity ownership changed') end; if prop('NAME')~=row.Name or prop('PORTRAIT')~='ICON_'..leader then error('name or portrait reference changed') end; if prop('PERSONALITY')~='CALM' or prop('TRAIT')~='ASTUTE' then error('fixture personality/trait changed') end; if prop('STATE')~='GREAT_PERSON' or count~=1 or gov~=nil or governors:HasGovernor(def.Hash) then error('expected exactly one native Great Person and no Governor') end; if unit:GetID()~=prop('UNIT') then error('saved unit id differs') end; if Locale.Lookup(unit:GetName())~=Locale.Lookup(row.Name) then error('native Great Person name differs: '..tostring(unit:GetName())) end; if unit:GetGreatPerson():GetActionCharges()~=0 then error('persona can retire by using a charge') end; local _,_,texture=IconManager:FindIconAtlas(row.PortraitIcon,64); if texture==nil then error('leader portrait unresolved') end; return 'native Great Person, name, portrait, zero charges, personality and trait verified'
